html:
Juan Ponce de Leon was the Spanish conquistador who led the conquest of Puerto Rico from 1508 and became its first governor. He had sailed with Columbus on his second voyage.

He founded the first settlement, Caparra, near today's San Juan, and divided the Taino among the settlers as forced labour. In 1511 the Taino rose against them and were crushed; disease and overwork destroyed most of the rest.

In 1513 he sailed north and reached a land he named Florida. The legend that he sought a fountain of youth came later. He died in Havana in 1521 of a wound from an arrow fired by Calusa warriors in Florida.
